verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote as the large, legible hero and puts the can over the circle as in the original, but the attribution sits almost on the last quote line, the centred logo breaks the left axis, and the gap above the quote is large. B shrinks the quote to small body text, so the yellow attribution outweighs the message and the hierarchy is inverted. B's can also floats mid-canvas, detached from the circle, which is left alone in the corner with the logo crowding its edge, and there is dead space throughout.
